assumptions: The owner chose an integrated four-capability bank story after the initial assessment: Fabric IQ for business data and semantics, Foundry IQ for cited institutional knowledge, Work IQ for work context, and Web IQ for public-web intelligence. The platform stage reference schema has no owner-decision source type, so this choice is documented without a fabricated source reference.
A particular bank process, audience, actor, data set, or decision is not yet selected. Any example used during design is illustrative until the owner confirms it.

The implementation mode is unresolved: synthetic representations, live services, or a combination are not assumed to have been approved. No access to real bank data, tenant resources, or Microsoft service integrations is established.

There are no supplied attachments, approved predecessor outputs, or matching curated knowledge references. No quantitative, regulatory, security, availability, or performance targets are inferred from the story.

open_questions.question: Which exact bank workflow, primary actors, and observable task should the integrated walkthrough demonstrate?
open_questions.context: The story specifies a bank demo but no process or users; the research note's briefing is only an illustration, not a mandated use case.

open_questions.question: What counts as a full demo: a navigable end-to-end walkthrough, a locally runnable application, a deployed demonstration, live services, or some agreed combination?
open_questions.context: The execution and completion boundary must be settled before implementation and end-to-end acceptance.

open_questions.question: For each of Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Work IQ, and Web IQ, must the demo use a live integration or a clearly labeled illustrative representation, and what tenant, subscription, credentials, licenses, costs, and preview access are available if live?
open_questions.context: The four contributions are in scope by owner choice, but service connection and data provenance are not established.

open_questions.question: If real bank data, documents, employee work context, or live tenant services will be used, what authorization, data classification, privacy, access, retention, audit, geography, and organizational or regulatory constraints apply?
open_questions.context: This blocks any real-data or live-service design; no such permissions or obligations can be inferred from the story.

requirements.statement: The demo shall present an end-to-end bank-oriented walkthrough that connects the four IQ contributions to one owner-selected task.
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner-selected bank task and an agreed execution mode, when a viewer completes the walkthrough, then the viewer can identify how Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Work IQ, and Web IQ each contribute to that same task.

requirements.statement: The demo shall use executable Python code to provide scenario content consumed by the bank-oriented walkthrough.
acceptance_criteria: Given the agreed runnable demo configuration, when the walkthrough requests scenario content, then executing Python code supplies content that the walkthrough presents.

requirements.statement: The demo shall use a React interface to let a viewer navigate the bank-oriented walkthrough.
acceptance_criteria: Given the agreed runnable demo configuration, when a viewer opens the React interface and follows the walkthrough, then the viewer can reach the four capability contributions without editing application code.

requirements.statement: The demo shall show a bank-relevant business datum together with its defined business meaning as the Fabric IQ contribution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the selected bank scenario, when a viewer inspects the Fabric IQ contribution, then the viewer can see a scenario datum and a corresponding business definition or semantic relationship, with its illustrative or live status identified.

requirements.statement: The demo shall show a relevant institutional-knowledge passage with an identifiable document citation as the Foundry IQ contribution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the selected bank scenario, when a viewer inspects the Foundry IQ contribution, then the viewer can see a passage connected to the task and a citation identifying its document, with example material labeled as illustrative rather than actual bank policy.

requirements.statement: The demo shall show task-related collaboration or handoff context as the Work IQ contribution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the selected bank scenario, when a viewer inspects the Work IQ contribution, then the viewer can see a collaboration or handoff item relevant to the same task and can distinguish that work context from business data and institutional guidance.

requirements.statement: The demo shall show an attributed public-web item relevant to the task as the Web IQ contribution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the selected bank scenario, when a viewer inspects the Web IQ contribution, then the viewer can identify the public source of a task-related item and distinguish it from internal business, document, and work context.

requirements.statement: The demo shall distinguish illustrative scenario evidence from evidence retrieved through an actual service.
acceptance_criteria: Given an agreed illustrative, live, or mixed execution mode, when a viewer inspects each displayed contribution, then the viewer can tell whether its content is illustrative or actually retrieved, without an example being presented as a bank record, policy, employee interaction, or live public-web result.
